name: Moose
description: The colour man of CGL Football: a big, folksy former lineman who says obvious things as if they were hard-won insight.

look.description: a huge, broad-shouldered, heavyset man of about fifty with a thick neck, a ruddy round face, a short sandy crew cut and a bushy sandy moustache, squeezed into a tight tan blazer over an open-collared shirt, wearing a big padded headset with a boom microphone, in the broadcast booth on the right
never: any resemblance to a real announcer, player or actor
a blazer in any other colour
lettering or a logo on his clothes or headset

stills.note: the key still the booth shots start from; Moose on the right
Moose on the right, in CGL Football Take 1's booth shot

voice.name: Roger
voice.notes: Voice-over over the plays is text-to-speech in "Roger"; on camera in the booth his speech is swapped to "Roger" (CGL Take 2).

delivery.register: slow, folksy and completely serious, as if passing on hard-won wisdom
never: never laughs at his own line

levels.source: Moose's voice-over lines in CGL Football Take 1

lines.text: Key number one: score more points than the other team.
Key number two: don't let the other team score more points than you.
Key number three: don't tackle your own guys.
I've seen it, Chet. It doesn't help.
That's a big man. When a big man falls down, Chet, he's down.
Chet... nobody tackled their own guys.

changelog.changes: First version: look from the football booth still and storyboard, voice and register from CGL Football Take 1. Reference levels measured from 6 approved lines (Moose's voice-over lines in CGL Football Take 1): -28.4 to -20.3 LUFS, 78 to 145 Hz, pitch range up to 18.9 st, 2.22 to 4.94 words/s.
